content.text: Home > News > Sports > How to Watch UCF vs UCLA Bruins: NCAA Tournament Broadcast Schedule & Viewing Guide Ad Disclosure The UCF Knights face the UCLA Bruins in a neutral site NCAA Men’s Basketball postseason matchup. This is the first ever meeting between the two programs. The Knights return to the tournament for the first time since 2019 after tying for seventh in the Big 12 standings. Head coach Mick Cronin leads a Bruins squad that arrives with momentum after a strong finish in the Big Ten. Neither team currently sits in the AP Top 25. Watch UCF vs UCLA on FuboTV. Readers looking to catch the action will find everything they need below. This guide covers the scheduled tip off time, the arena location in Philadelphia, the live television channel, and all available streaming options for the game. When is UCF vs UCLA? What Time Does It Start? The neutral site postseason game between the UCF Knights and the UCLA Bruins is scheduled for Friday, March 20, 2026. Tip off for the contest is officially set for 7:25 PM ET. Where is UCF vs UCLA? The upcoming tournament game between the UCF Knights and the UCLA Bruins takes place at Xfinity Mobile Arena. The venue is located in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Because this is a neutral site matchup, the tournament selection committee designates the UCLA Bruins as the home team. The UCF Knights serve as the away team for the contest. How Can I Watch UCF vs UCLA? Fans planning to watch the postseason game between the UCF Knights and the UCLA Bruins can find the live television broadcast on TBS. The network provides full television coverage of the neutral site contest. Viewers can tune in directly to TBS for the scheduled 7:25 PM ET tip off. How Can I Stream UCF vs UCLA?
